subject: general
question: In October 2011, which country signed a five-year partnership agreement with India to implement a 'Green Strategic Partnership' for strengthening scientific and technology collaboration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Denmark**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Green Strategic Partnership**

 
 
• ​The virtual summit between **India **and **Denmark **was co-chaired by** H.E. Mette Frederiksen**, Prime Minister of **Denmark**, and** H.E. Narendra Modi, Prime Minister of India**, on **September 28, 2020**. The two Prime Ministers decided to upgrade the ties between **India **and **Denmark **to a **Green Strategic Partnership** at this point.
 
• They expressed delight at the continuous growth of bilateral ties, which are founded on shared democratic traditions, **historical ties**, and a desire for regional and** global peace** and **stability**.
 
• The agreement establishing a Joint Commission for Cooperation between **India **and **Denmark **is built upon and strengthened by the** Green Strategic cooperation.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Both **India **and **Denmark **have high aspirations for the** global climate agenda**. India is currently the** third-largest CO2** emitter in the world, and by **2030**, it is anticipated that its carbon emissions would have doubled.
 
• The** Danish government** wants to take global leadership on** SDG 7** on access to affordable and clean energy and has a goal of reducing **CO2** emissions by** 70% **by 2030.
 
• By working together, **India **and **Denmark **will show the rest of the world that it is possible to achieve ambitious **climate **and** sustainable energy targets**.
